title: The TCP Maximum Segment Size and Related Topics
summary: This RFC clarifies the TCP Maximum Segment Size option and how it interacts with IP, offering advice to implementers. It explains what the option means and why getting it wrong causes trouble. It is historic and was replaced by RFC 7805 and RFC 9293.

eli5.summary: When you mail a package you need to know the biggest box the post office takes. This note explains how two computers tell each other the biggest chunk of data they will accept.
